native.referenceAuthority: docs/design/poros-stitch/README.md; approved dark screens, light screens, consolidated design prose
native.componentPolicy: Compose components are documented in DESIGN.md. Native dp/sp, Material state behavior and overlay elevation remain authoritative.
native.font: Bundled inter_variable.ttf, explicit 400/500/600 weight instances, optical size 14sp, system glyph fallback. Display/headline/title roles enable tnum.
native.icons: Bundled Lucide ImageVectors, 24-unit grid, 1.75-unit rounded strokes. Native Material control-state glyphs.
native.wallpaper: Android 12+ opt-in setting replaces supporting secondary/tertiary roles. Poros primary, surfaces and atmosphere positive role remain stable.
native.systemBars: Nearest DialogWindowProvider ancestor owns dialog bars, with Activity fallback. Contrast applies to the owning window decor and posts reapplication after composition and native focus dispatch.
native.compactControls: At fontScale <= 1.15 Library uses a horizontally scrollable Media/Status/Sort Choice toolbar and Settings uses native System/Light/Dark segmented buttons. Larger text uses full-width stacked choices and radio rows.
native.entryWorkflows: Prominent title fields, compact native date/time triggers and one Save action. More options summarizes retained optional values and reveals fields on validation errors. Event date/time pairs stack above fontScale 1.15. Money uses amount/account/category as primary fields and wrapping section tabs. Today uses one financial focal card with open supporting sections.
native.branding: Native core/orbit mark with adaptive foreground/background and Android 13+ monochrome icon resources.
native.verification: Source extraction only in this documentation pass. See docs/poros-redesign-handover.md for implementation and measured verification.
native.notCanonized: Decorative Quick Add subtitle copy remains local to its sheet. Device/reference parity and accessibility verification belong to implementation review.

narrative.overview: Poros uses charcoal tonal layers, restrained indigo actions, compact information groups and clear financial figures. Light mode carries the same shared native Compose components onto a pale canvas with white panels.
keyCharacteristics: Signature dark appearance with paired light semantic roles.
Flat rounded panels and bundled Inter/Lucide assets.
Native Material 3 navigation, controls, sheets and editors.

rules.name: The Stable Indigo Rule
rules.body: Optional Android wallpaper colors customize supporting secondary and tertiary roles while preserving Poros primary, surfaces and financial positive color.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Use Material color/content pairs and shared panel roles across both themes.

rules.name: The Financial Meaning Rule
rules.body: Retain currency, period and recorded-versus-upcoming meaning beside financial amounts.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy through shared canvas and container roles with flat resting cards.

dos: **Do** consume shared theme roles and Poros primitives for both appearances.
**Do** use bundled Inter, outline vectors, native focus feedback and accessible labels.
**Do** retain wrapping, touch targets, system insets and scrollable editors.
**Do** preserve currency-specific totals and explicit financial and schedule status.
donts: **Don't** introduce repeated glowing borders or excessive decorative effects.
**Don't** substitute icon-font glyphs for the shared vector family.
**Don't** turn fictional reference content into product capabilities.
